[[File:Dark Energon Orb v2.png|thumb|220x220px]]
==Description==
''Found in the Dark Energon Mines of New Quintessa in Act 2 Chapter 3. It emanates and ominous violet glow that belies its origin as the blood of Unicron. A single atom is enough to corrupt even the most righteous Bot.''

==Boosts==
*Increase Commander XP gains by 5%.
==Obtainment==
Complete [[Dissension and Ascension|Act 2]] Chapter 3.
